title: Skeletrom Crew On The Loose!
author: Kai Stewart
description:
It is the night of All Hallows Eve, and you and your skellingtime crew are the scariest dudes in the whole boneyard.

It is the night of All Hallows Eve, the one night a year that you and your fellow bonefolk emerge from your sleep of death. One by one, your skelertrong crew drag themselves from the mortal loam and shake off the clods of grave dirt. Goths would think this is just the greatest.

Play as one of five (and a bit) skellegrombs to build a chair, reconnect with your ex, become a bog, or otherwise follow the demands of your bony soul.

Content warning: Gore, worms and insects
